title: ECS Container Crash / Node Not Ready
description: Multi-step recovery for ECS task crashes and node failures. Each step refers to a diagnostic checklist file in S3 before deciding the action.

decision_tree.name: Check container exit code
decision_tree.instruction: Read the exit code from the container. Use the exit code reference file to classify the failure type.

decision_tree.name: Verify cluster health before restart
decision_tree.instruction: Before restarting, verify the cluster has enough capacity. If capacity < 20%, scale out first.

decision_tree.name: Post-restart verification
decision_tree.instruction: After restart, check service reaches STEADY_STATE within 5 minutes. If not, escalate.

feedback_notes: Works well for OOMKilled (exit 137) and app crashes (exit 1). Node-level failures need health check first.
